content:
I'm a total noob here so don't know if this appropriate. I am not a mathematician, I am a software dev/architect but in my spare time and with my own spare tokens I have put together a rather large Lean project looking into RH.

I don't know if any of it useful to others, and if not I will just keep using it for my own purposes. I don't really need a review, decide for yourself if it's useful or not.

You can find the work here:- https://github.com/artifish26/riemann-hypothesis-lean/blob/main/CLAIMS.md
I think it's a pretty comprehensive formalization.

If nobodies interested, so be it.

I would like to thanks Prof A Kontorovich for giving me the time of day and suggesting I put it here.
Thanks Eric. Very relevant. I might see if I can incorporate some of their well structured project around the zero counting
